verdict.rationale: Rive has file-level Revision History with non-destructive restores, but nothing in the evidence presents scripts, agent tasks, or anything else as discrete automations that can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back on their own. Whole-file revision history is an adjacent capability, not automation versioning. No review or approval workflow for automations is documented either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
